column1: # band_native.tsv — THIS HOST's message band, frame by frame (design ruling 333 of
# asserts it; rewrite with ATERM_BAND_GOLDEN=write) and read by aterm-wasm's
# through the web module and must land on every digest. Digests are FNV-1a-64 of each
# band row's RenderCells (Debug), its ChromeRasters (Debug) and its RGBA pixel rows,
# the ChromeBleed (Debug) and the pixels above the grid. Both hosts draw with the
# bundled JetBrains Mono at 20 px on the portable rasterizer, pad 6, links withheld.
# The colour arithmetic runs on THIS host's libm (macOS libSystem here): on another
# libm both tests would flag the same last-place difference together (ruling 326 (g)),
# which is a platform fact, not a web defect.
